sources.title: GitHub - furkannane/PPO-LunarLander-v3
sources.snippet: This project implements Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) — one of the most powerful and stable policy gradient algorithms in Reinforcement Learning — entirely from scratch in PyTorch. The environment used for training is LunarLander-v3 from the OpenAI Gymnasium suite.
